ToolHint.fill: draw a loop to fill it
ToolHint.fillLong: Draw a closed loop: the inside is filled with the current colour. Great for silhouettes and shadows.
ToolHint.eraserLong: Removes drawing only. The token's original image is never touched. Pen erasers work automatically.

Toolbar.Label: Drawing tools for {name}
Toolbar.Drag: Drag to move · double-click to reset
Toolbar.PressureMouse: Mouse detected: pressure is simulated from drawing speed — slow strokes are bolder.
Toolbar.PeerEditing: {name} is also drawing on this token

Status.errorHint: Saving failed. Your strokes are kept locally and saving will be retried.
Status.offlineHint: The server did not answer. Your strokes are kept locally and saving will be retried.

Menu.ExportPngFull: Export token with drawing as PNG
Menu.Prototype: Use as actor's default token drawing

Hud.Replace: Replace mode: redraw the token image

Controls.Create: Scribble token: click the map to place a blank token and draw

Placement.Hint: Click on the map to place a scribble token · Shift: no grid snapping · Esc: cancel

Create.Name: Create scribble token at cursor
Create.Hint: Creates a blank, transparent token under the mouse and starts drawing on it.

Edit.Name: Draw on selected token
Edit.Hint: Starts drawing on the selected (or hovered) token, keeping its image intact.

Replace.Name: Redraw selected token image (replace mode)
Replace.Hint: Opens the replace-mode editor for the selected (or hovered) token: the result is saved as a new image file and the original is backed up in the world folder.

Draft.Title: Restore unsaved drawing?
Draft.Content: TokenScribble found strokes on this token that were not saved (from {time}). Restore them?

Corrupt.Title: Drawing data unreadable
Corrupt.Content: The drawing stored on this token could not be read. You can start a new drawing; the unreadable data is replaced when you save.

Revert.Title: Discard changes?
Revert.Content: This removes everything you drew in this session and restores what you erased or undid. Strokes added by other users are kept.

Prototype.Title: Use as default drawing?
Prototype.Content: New tokens of {name} will start with this drawing. Existing tokens are not changed.

Notify.NotReady: TokenScribble: this token is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
Notify.NoPermission: TokenScribble: you do not have permission to modify this token.
Notify.NoCreatePermission: TokenScribble: you do not have permission to create tokens in this scene.
Notify.PermissionLost: TokenScribble: you no longer have permission to modify this token. Drawing stopped.
Notify.CreateFailed: TokenScribble: the token could not be created.
Notify.StartFailed: TokenScribble: drawing could not be started. See the console for details.
Notify.NewerFormat: TokenScribble: this drawing was made with a newer version of TokenScribble. Update the module to edit it.
Notify.Budget: TokenScribble: this drawing reached the storage limit ({max} KB). Erasing does not free space; use Clear or ask the GM to raise the limit.
Notify.AlsoEditing: TokenScribble: {names} is also drawing on this token. Changes are merged automatically.
Notify.SavedLocally: TokenScribble: could not reach the server. Your drawing is kept in this browser and will be offered again next time.
Notify.Pasted: TokenScribble: pasted {count} strokes (Ctrl+Z undoes the paste).
Notify.Cleared: TokenScribble: drawing cleared (Ctrl+Z brings it back).
Notify.Reverted: TokenScribble: this session's changes were discarded.
Notify.LayerHidden: TokenScribble: drawing hidden. The data is kept.
Notify.PrototypeSaved: TokenScribble: new tokens of {name} will use this drawing.
Notify.SelectFirst: TokenScribble: select a token first (or press N to create a new one).
Notify.Unsupported: TokenScribble requires Foundry VTT v13 or newer.

MaxKB.Name: Storage limit per token (KB)
MaxKB.Hint: Upper bound for one token's drawing data. Drawings are stored in the scene, so very large values make scenes heavier to load.

TokenSize.Name: Size of new scribble tokens
TokenSize.Hint: Grid size used for tokens created with the shortcut or the scene control.

CreateHidden.Name: GM: create scribble tokens hidden
CreateHidden.Hint: Lets the GM finish a drawing before players can see it. Reveal it from the Token HUD.

Pressure.Name: Pressure
Pressure.Hint: Auto uses stylus pressure when available and simulates it for mice.

AutoFocus.Name: Zoom to small tokens when drawing starts
AutoFocus.Hint: Smoothly zooms the map so a small token is comfortable to draw on, and returns afterwards.

Replace.Info: Saved as a new {w} × {h} PNG in this world's folder; the original image is backed up there first and can be restored at any time.
Replace.BakesOverlay: The token's in-place drawing is included and will be merged into the image.
Replace.Prototype: Also use for the actor's prototype token
Replace.NoActor: This token has no associated world actor.
Replace.OverflowLimit: You have reached the drawing limit: one original image long side beyond each edge.
Replace.SourceChanged: The source image changed while you were editing. Export your draft, then reopen the editor to load the current image.
Replace.EraserLong: In replace mode the eraser also removes pixels of the original image. Clearing brings the original back.
Replace.DiscardContent: The Token or portrait has unsaved changes. Close the editor and discard all unsaved drafts?
Replace.DoneToken: The image of {name} was replaced. The original is backed up.
Replace.DonePortrait: The portrait of {name} was replaced. The original is backed up.
Replace.BackupFailed: Could not back up the original image, so nothing was changed. Check that the image can be loaded and that you may upload files.
Replace.CrossOrigin: The original image comes from another site that does not allow it to be copied, so it cannot be edited here.
Replace.LoadFailed: Could not load the current image (missing file, or a remote image that does not allow copying).
Replace.Failed: Saving the image did not complete. Check the current token and prototype images before retrying. See the console for details.
Replace.RestoreContent: The original image (or its backup in the world folder) is put back. Generated images stay in the world folder.
Replace.Restored: The original image of {name} was restored.
Replace.RestoreFailed: Restoring the original image failed. See the console for details.
Replace.AlreadyOpen: Another replace-mode editor is already open. Finish or close it first.

Refused.permission: You do not have permission to change this image.
Refused.files: Replace mode needs the “Upload New Files” and “Use File Browser” permissions. Ask your GM, or use in-place drawing instead.
Refused.video: Video images cannot be redrawn in replace mode. Use in-place drawing instead.
